PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 7, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56029  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56030  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, July 17, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56031  Recommendation to adopt resolution certifying that the Final Environmental Impact
  Report (EIR) for the First Citizens Bank Project at 3450-3470 Long Beach
  Boulevard (EIR-02-24, State Clearinghouse [SCH] Number 2024070597) has been

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 7, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  completed in accordance with the provisions of the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) and State and Local Guidelines and making certain findings
  and determinations relative thereto; and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and
  Reporting Program (MMRP);

  Approve Site Plan Review (SPR23-030) and adopt the proposed findings of fact
  and conditions of approval related thereto, for development of a new 12,469
  square foot, two-story, 34 feet high bank building with a walk-up Automated Teller
  Machine (ATM) and 44 surface parking spaces at site within the high-rise overlay
  district (HR-4) in the Community Automobile-Oriented (CCA) Zoning District; and

  Approve a Lot Merger request (LMG23-002) and adopt the proposed findings of
  fact and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow merger of three parcels
  (APN: 7145-006-010, 7145-006-011, and 7145-006-012) into a single 36,750-
  square-foot (0.84-acre) lot. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56032  Recommendation to receive and file the eighth annual review of the Golden Shore
  Project Development Agreement (DA) affirming staff’s finding that the project
  complies with the terms and conditions as required and has fulfilled the
  requirements for the reporting period of July 2023 through June 2024. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56033  Recommendation to receive and file the ninth annual review of the Golden Shore
  Project Development Agreement (DA) affirming staff’s finding that the project
  complies with the terms and conditions as required and has fulfilled the
  requirements for the reporting period of July 2024 through June 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56034  Recommendation to find that the environmental impacts of the Inclusionary
  Housing Implementation Guidelines were assessed in the previously adopted
  Categorical Exemption (CE-24-174), and that no further environmental analysis is
  required; and

  Adopt resolution adopting Inclusionary Housing Implementation Guidelines, in
  accordance with the Inclusionary Housing Ordinance, Section 21.67.090.D of the
  Zoning Regulations contained in the Long Beach Municipal Code. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56035  Recommendation to find the projects listed in the proposed Fiscal Year 2026
  Capital Improvement Program (FY 2026 CIP) in conformity with the General Plan.

  Page 2 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, AUGUST 7, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
